housing: Reno renters live in apartment complexes, older houses and small multi-unit buildings near Midtown and the university, and single-family homes in newer suburbs.
climate: Test the furnace and any evaporative cooler or AC, and check that outside pipes are protected; Reno is dry, with freezing winter nights and hot summers.
fact: Washoe Legal Services, now listed as Northern Nevada Legal Aid, gives free help to low-income Reno tenants facing eviction.
